setup: fake credentials (sk-ant-oat01-FAKE-A/B), a per-session link CLAUDE_SECURESTORAGE_CONFIG_DIR=<pool-links/pool-t/sess-1> -> subs/sub-A, a loopback mock for the API + OAuth + OTLP, a network namespace with only lo (sudo unshare -n); the mock records the Authorization header of every /v1/messages request

overwrite.change: B bytes written in place into A/.credentials.json (same inode)

hardlink-mtime.change: A/.credentials.json := hard link to B (new inode), mtime bumped

hardlink-same.change: A/.credentials.json := hard link to B (new inode), mtime = A old mtime

slowstream.change: msg2 streams its one text block for 25 s

findings.perTurnCheck: every turn the CLI statx()es $CLAUDE_SECURESTORAGE_CONFIG_DIR/.credentials.json THROUGH the link and re-reads the file when mtimeMs differs from the last one it saw (decompiled Rd -> QS, lastCredentialsMtimeMs); the next request carries the new token
findings.followsTheLink: symlink re-point (with or without the utimes bump), in-place overwrite and a hard-link replacement with a new mtime are all followed on the next turn (B:200)
findings.blindSpot: a replacement whose mtime EQUALS the old one (hardlink-same) is NOT seen: the process keeps A -- the utimes bump in repointPoolSymlink is load-bearing
findings.utimesOnly: utimes with unchanged content re-reads the file (openat) and keeps the same token
findings.refresh: after a re-point the refresh path locks <link>/.oauth_refresh.lock AND the link target resolved via /proc/self/fd (subs/sub-B.lock) and re-reads through the link -- it follows the link; no token POST was made in this setup (the token had 4.5 min left against a 5-min buffer, the CLI declined under the lock), so the refresh WRITE target was not observed directly
findings.noLocalGate: after a 429 the next turn makes a real request again (no local gate); after a re-point the next turn is B:200
findings.otelOrg: OTel organization.id = ~/.claude.json oauthAccount.organizationUuid (the scratch HOME's eeeeeeee) for BOTH tokens -- a machine-wide label, never the account a request billed; the CLI refetches its own profile at start when profileFetchedAt is older than 24 h (gF=86400000) and rewrites that label machine-wide
findings.timestamp: every assistant record (success and API error) carries `timestamp` stamped at EMISSION: a text block streamed for 25 s arrived 2 ms after its stamp
